errors.text_span: с изключение на 2008 г., когато износът (15,3 млрд. EUR) е по-голям от вноса (25,2 млрд. EUR)
errors.evidence: The description claims that in 2008, exports (15.3 billion EUR) were greater than imports (25.2 billion EUR). This is factually incorrect as 15.3 is less than 25.2. The chart shows that for all years, including 2008, imports are greater than exports.
